name: biomcp
description: BioMCP-TS — TypeScript biomedical MCP server (genes, variants, trials, literature, patents, R analysis)

scripts.build: tsc && esbuild dist/server/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --minify --external:undici --external:mysql2 --external:node:sqlite --external:webr --outfile=dist/bundle.js && esbuild dist/cli/main.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --minify --external:undici --external:mysql2 --external:node:sqlite --external:webr --outfile=dist/cli.js && esbuild dist/db/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --minify --external:undici --external:mysql2 --external:node:sqlite --external:webr --outfile=dist/db.js && esbuild dist/biowasm/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --minify --external:undici --external:mysql2 --external:node:sqlite --external:webr --outfile=dist/biowasm.js && esbuild dist/biowasm/worker.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --minify --external:undici --external:mysql2 --external:node:sqlite --external:webr --outfile=dist/biowasm-worker.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:coverage-all: npm run test:coverage && npm run test:integration -- --coverage
